note: Independent re-judge after 4ceb0f7416 (not the author of either changed unit). Section 4 read in rfc/full/rfc6996.txt: "Private Use ASNs MUST be removed from AS path attributes (including AS4_PATH if utilizing a four-octet AS number space) before being advertised to the global Internet." Changed units: (1) TestRFC6996OldSpeakerReceivesStrippedASPathAndAS4Path (reactor) receives from an OLD speaker AS_PATH [65100 64496 64512 23456 23456 64497] + AS4_PATH [65100 64496 64512 4200000000 65536 64497], forwards through ForwardUpdate with an export member answering as-path remove "private" toward a two-octet EBGP peer, and asserts the exact AS_PATH value 0204 fde8 fbf0 5ba0 fbf1 and the exact AS4_PATH value [65000 64496 65536 64497]. Q1/Q4: this is the end-to-end proof the previous verdict said was owed: for a two-octet destination both emitted path attributes are free of 65100, 64512 and 4200000000, so an AS4_PATH transcoded from the received rather than the stripped path, or a strip applied to one attribute only, turns it red; the kept 65536 (RFC 5398, outside both ranges) also pins the outside-range side. Q3: input isolates the strip (no confed, no AS_SET). Strip-before-prepend is pinned by the expected local 65000; the fixture's local AS is itself private, which a speaker cannot remove (RFC 4271 prepend), so it does not contradict the requirement. Break filter_delta.go:747 removePrivateASOps dropping the AS_PATH set op is the real producer of the strip on this path and was observed red. (2) TestRFC6996StripsPrivateUseASN claim narrowed to detection: body asserts asPathFieldHasPrivateASN reports 64512 in [64496 64512 64497]; claim now equals assertion; break private_as.go:46 >= to > is the true lower-edge off-by-one, observed red. Unchanged units keep the earlier reading: the reactor export unit asserts exact stripped bytes at all four range edges, AS4_PATH units assert the exact set op and zero ops for outside neighbours, plugin units assert per-edge intent and accept for neighbours. Both polarities genuine.
